summary: The entrance hall is presented in very good, clean decorative condition overall with modern fittings, light oak-effect plank flooring, and dark bronze electrical switches. Minor localized wear is documented, including several faint scuff marks and rub blemishes mid-to-low level on the painted walls, light edge wear to the internal letterbox flap, and an angle chip to the leading edge of the utility/storage cupboard door. The ceiling, lighting fixtures, digital screen, and flooring appear in excellent order.
